s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with pelvic pain and urinary frequency
salient_findings: Worsening right-sided pelvic pain
Urinary frequency
Heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion involving the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass encasing the right external iliac artery
High-grade tumor with frequent mitoses and necrosis
key_facts: 54-year-old woman
History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma
Treated with mastectomy and chemoradiation 4 years earlier
Presenting with urinary frequency
Worsening right-sided pelvic pain
Weight loss
MRI showed multiple fibroids and a heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion
Mass involved the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass encased the right external iliac artery
Tumor had fleshy solid and cystic components
Central hemorrhage and necrosis present
High nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios
Frequent mitoses (32 per 10 high-power fields)
Diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: High-grade tumor with fleshy solid and cystic components, central hemorrhage, and necrosis, consistent with leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: High-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse positivity for CD99 and presence of high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, and pseudo-rosette formation

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Undifferentiated morphology and high-grade features, including frequent mitoses and necrosis

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma of the uterus
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse positivity for CD99, consistent with Ewing sarcoma, and presence of small, round hyperchromatic cells

shortlist.label: Uterine metastasis from breast carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma and presence of a high-grade pelvic mass

raw.rationale: The tumor's microscopic features, including small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, and pseudo-rosette formation, along with diffuse positivity for CD99, are characteristic of Ewing sarcoma.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's microscopic features and immunohistochemical profile do not match those typical of leiomyosarcoma, which usually shows positivity for smooth muscle markers like desmin and SMA.

rejected.label: High-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's morphology and immunohistochemical stains, particularly the diffuse positivity for CD99 and negativity for CD10, do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
rejected.why: While the tumor is high-grade and undifferentiated, the specific features and immunohistochemical profile point towards a more specific diagnosis of Ewing sarcoma.

rejected.label: Uterine metastasis from breast carcinoma
rejected.why: The tumor's microscopic features and immunohistochemical profile do not match those of the patient's known breast carcinoma, and the presence of CD99 positivity suggests a different primary tumor type.
